exact_source_api.entry: studio.worker._train(kind=train.classify-text, parameters, inputs.dataset, out) validates named recipe, holds GPU, calls train.run.run with dry=(mode==smoke), materializes checkpoint/model only outside smoke.
exact_source_api.request: Seven Studio parameters steps/context/batch_size/learning_rate/size/framework/mode; canonical standalone reuses semantic enum choices and parameter order but not StudioGraphScalarRef/DraftRef contexts. Dataset native path and output path are existing implementation details, not public wire fields.
exact_source_api.recipe: contracts/recipes/classify-text.json exact defaults steps1000/context128/batch32/lr0.001; steps20..200000/context32..2048/batch1..512/lr1e-5..0.1; size small or medium; automatic resolution remains source-profile bound.
exact_source_api.data: read_labelled uses ordered .jsonl files, replacement decoding, skips blank/invalid JSON/nonobject/blank text, converts non-null labels with Python str; classifier sorts vocabulary and requires at least two labels. The recipe descriptive min_rows100 is not enforced by this handler; no invented minimum is imposed. Exact normalization/conversion/order profiles must be implemented, not replaced by generic JSON wire.
exact_source_api.initial_model: Source classifier constructs a new Torch/MLX classifier; no pretrained input. Split seed defaults0. Initialization is not explicitly seeded by current builder; new canonical init policy/seed and post-admission initial weight digest are NEW guarantees, not proven legacy determinism.
exact_source_api.result: train.run returns recipe,steps,final_loss,best_metric,checkpoint,parameters,seconds,dry_run,stop_reason,phases and manifest outside smoke. Checkpoint/manifest/model paths become node-owned refs; no LoRA/export gateway or arbitrary recipe registration/import in this intent.
exact_source_api.cancel_resume: Trainer checks should_stop before a step and normally saves final checkpoint on exit when write_checkpoints; smoke writes no checkpoint. Resume restores weights/optimizer, but current source does not prove full RNG/batch-cursor state. Complete resume witnesses below are intended NEW requirements.

representation_revision.wire: JobPreparationView now contains closed per-intent details. This IS a proposed wire revision, NOT backward compatible; old flat repair-view fixture explicitly refuses. No active runtime consumers are migrated.
representation_revision.repair: Original JobPreparationEffect/candidate/authority value types remain in mandatory JobRepairPreparationDetails. JobFrozenRepairPlan uses singleton JobRepairIntent. Repair-specific protected approval, cancel-before-replacement-fence and unknown-effect recovery requirements remain.
representation_revision.standalone: Training dataset/checkpoint/output refs carry installation+incarnation and node-issued IDs, never project/workflow/Studio-run requirements. They are lookup DATA, not native access or provenance. Pure local Python training remains usable without node/workspace/project.
representation_revision.reuse: Existing size/framework/mode choices, field-order keys, observed-number/optional-float/stop/phase types where semantics match; no fake StudioGraph draft or StudioControl run to reuse context-bound numeric/artifact refs. Optional real-Studio projection is deferred.
representation_revision.model: Optional ModelRef is OUTPUT only after verified model publication; absence never means an input pretrained model. Source from-scratch constructor identity is explicit.

intended_durable_design.one_ledger: Same five jobs.prepare/submit/preparations.inspect/cancel/watch operations and node-owned admission; no new operation, scheduler, launcher or arbitrary intent escape. Current authorization checks branch on the exact closed intent; repair checks stay repair-specific.
intended_durable_design.lookup_authority: Before disclosure/replay/each event, verify actual principal, installation/incarnation and live dataset/checkpoint/output ownership. A project-free dataset snapshot must have node-retained native input handles or protected immutable custody issued from authorized local selection/import; no reference, digest, caller label or invented issuer callback establishes this. Issuing adapter integration is required before enablement. No pool membership/workspace/project prerequisite or blanket person prompt; genuinely protected resource permissions still apply.
intended_durable_design.prepare: Real CPU/memory/storage/input-output admission before scan, normalization, verification, staging, retained metadata or resume tensor inspection. Freeze immutable file manifest+ordering/content/parser profile, accepted rows, vocabulary/split, resolved numeric defaults, size/framework, recipe/backend/toolchain/constructor digests, initialization policy/seed, expiry and revisions. Hold authorized dataset and output roots/descriptors privately; no public paths/secrets or hidden scan allocations. No model/weights allocation during preparation. Frozen resolved parameters have mandatory numeric fields and closed small/medium, Torch/MLX choices: omitted/automatic request preferences cannot survive as unresolved plan values.
intended_durable_design.estimates: Source plan_for computes LoRA fit, not classifier fit. TrainingEstimate unknown/measured is intended measured classifier resource-profile data, not a fabricated source estimate. Known profile binds exact architecture/dataset/config/backend/resource generation; unknown memory/compute/output reservation or invalid finite learning rate refuses launch. No new throughput constants or arbitrary caps. Actual current aggregate admission remains authoritative and must be reacquired/revalidated at submit, including smoke20.
intended_durable_design.submit: Reauthorize before replay and action; expected revision, exact plan/source/config/dataset/backend/profile/output/expiry and resource ownership must still match. RequestId/content replay attaches, conflict refuses; same plan new RequestId never launches twice; unresolved normalized intent/output fence prevents restart via reprepare without blocking unrelated admitted jobs. Consume launch-intent fence before one existing admitted worker path; record exact actual initial weights digest only after admitted construction and before first step. No deterministic replay claim without a proved init profile.
intended_durable_design.effects: Training launch fence and later output-publication fence are distinct durable transactions; neither is an artifact success receipt. Repair replacement fence behavior is unchanged. Unknown effect stays unknown and retains node custody, never blind rerun.
intended_durable_design.cancel: Before launch fence, atomic cancellation means no model execution. After launch, cooperative should_stop at step boundary, checkpoint if non-smoke/source permits, then verify owned holder/descendants stopped, immutable outputs/checkpoint reconciled and all resource/storage reservations settled before settled_cancelled. Output publication won or unknown means not cancelled. No PID-only kill, false stop, premature resource release or source repair cancellation semantics reused for running training.
intended_durable_design.recovery: Crash/holder loss marks interrupted/reconciling; do not automatically restart. Reconcile exact worker generation, launch/publication fences and held output/checkpoint custody. Explicit new preparation with initialization=resume requires exact checkpoint/config/data/vocabulary/split/backend/toolchain/optimizer/RNG/batch-cursor witness and exclusive output allocation; unknown/incomplete legacy witness refuses exact resume. No guessed latest path or claimed legacy RNG fidelity.
intended_durable_design.result: Node-owned output refs bind job+installation/incarnation+content digest+bytes and retained storage authority; checkpoint ref maps to protected manifest including all continuation state. Publish ModelRef only after independently verified immutable artifacts and model registry admission. Metrics preserve unavailable/nonfinite observations in existing typed forms, redact before persistence/events. Smoke has no checkpoint/manifest/model publication and still uses actual admission. Binary-output retrieval must use reviewed existing resource transport or explicit followup contract; references alone provide no access.
intended_durable_design.numeric_profiles: Numeric request fields use canonical bounded U32 for integer recipe ranges and FiniteF64 bits; learning-rate range1e-5..0.1, exact defaults, duplicates/order consistency and source coercion differences require semantic validation. Wire decoding alone does not enforce relational/profile/runtime policy. No arbitrary scalar/JSON/CLI escape. The node must verify effective_steps equals resolved steps for train or min(resolved steps,20) for smoke, and that resolved values plus initialization/backend/architecture match the frozen constructor digest; changing any requires a new authorized plan.
